tasks.subject: Task 1: Device spike — ALSA routing mechanics
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove on the RG SP that an env-supplied ALSA config can reroute a port's "default" PCM (config include + `pcm.!default` override + absolute-path plugin `lib` key), and record the exact working config text.

**Files:**
- No repo changes (throwaway spike; findings recorded as a task comment; correct Task 3/4 templates if contradicted)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A file passed via `ALSA_CONFIG_PATH` that starts with `</usr/share/alsa/alsa.conf>` and redefines `pcm.!default` as `type plug` over a verbatim copy of the stock hooks chain still plays port audio (hw_ptr advances on /proc/asound/card0/pcm0p/sub0/status while Balatro runs with the env set)
- [ ] An absolute-path `pcm_type.<x>.lib` definition dlopens a module from a pak-style SD-card path (bluealsa-copy probe; args/connection error = PASS, "cannot open shared object" = FAIL — then isolate noexec cause and record workaround)
- [ ] Findings posted as a comment on this task
- [ ] Device left clean (spike files removed, no port left running, no launch.sh modified)

**Verify:** `ssh root@10.0.1.16 'grep -E "state|hw_ptr" /proc/asound/card0/pcm0p/sub0/status'` ×2 ~0.5s apart → state RUNNING, hw_ptr advancing, while Balatro runs with the test env. Full recipe: plan Task 1 steps (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-port-sleep.md).

tasks.subject: Task 2: gt-sleepmon watcher daemon
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The C daemon: watches event0, freezes the port tree, runs the stock suspend script, unfreezes, swallows post-resume events; pure trigger logic host-tested.

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/gt-sleepmon.c` (full source in plan Task 2 Step 1 — use it verbatim)
- Modify: `Makefile` (arm64 container lane: add gt-sleepmon gcc line + extend `file` check)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `assets/gt-sleepmon.c` compiles in the bullseye arm64 container to `assets/gt-sleepmon`; `file` reports ELF 64-bit ARM aarch64
- [ ] Host test (`cc -DGT_SLEEPMON_TEST`) passes: power release triggers; power press/repeat don't; lid close (value 1) triggers; lid autorepeat/release and lid open don't; triggers inside the 2s swallow window ignored → prints `sleepmon-test-ok`
- [ ] TERM/INT/HUP handler and the post-suspend path both SIGCONT anything frozen (no orphaned-frozen tree possible)
- [ ] Suspend invoked via execle with explicit env (SYSTEM_PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/mnt/SDCARD/.system/h700/lib, system PATH — never the pak busybox-wrapper PATH); nonzero rv only logged, NEVER poweroff

**Verify:** `cc -DGT_SLEEPMON_TEST -o /tmp/gt-sleepmon-test assets/gt-sleepmon.c && /tmp/gt-sleepmon-test` → `sleepmon-test-ok`; `make shim` then `file assets/gt-sleepmon` → ELF 64-bit aarch64

```json:metadata
{"files": ["assets/gt-sleepmon.c", "Makefile"], "verifyCommand": "cc -DGT_SLEEPMON_TEST -o /tmp/gt-sleepmon-test assets/gt-sleepmon.c && /tmp/gt-sleepmon-test && file assets/gt-sleepmon", "acceptanceCriteria": ["container build ELF 64-bit aarch64", "host trigger-logic test prints sleepmon-test-ok", "all exit paths SIGCONT frozen tree", "explicit-env suspend exec, never poweroff"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: ALSA suspend-proxy plugin
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `libasound_module_pcm_gt_suspend.so` — ioplug proxy forwarding playback to the stock chain, transparently closing+reopening the slave when it detects a suspend, validated in the arm64 container against a null slave.

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/gt-alsa-suspend.c` (full source in plan Task 3 Step 1 — start from it verbatim, debug in container)
- Create: `tests/container-alsa-check.sh` (manual container functional check; NOT wired into tests/run.sh)
- Modify: `Makefile` (both lanes: compile plugin aarch64 + armhf, add libasound2-dev to both apt-get lines, extend `file` checks)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Plugin compiles in both lanes; `file`: ELF 64-bit aarch64 and ELF 32-bit ARM respectively
- [ ] Container check passes: aplay through the plugin over `type null` completes (exit 0), and GT_SUSPEND_FORCE_REOPEN=1 run completes AND logs `gt-alsa-suspend: reopening slave`
- [ ] Suspend detection = CLOCK_BOOTTIME−CLOCK_MONOTONIC delta jump; reopen bounded-retries (5×100ms) then surfaces errors — no infinite loop

**Verify:** `sh tests/container-alsa-check.sh` → last line `CONTAINER-ALSA-OK`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["assets/gt-alsa-suspend.c", "tests/container-alsa-check.sh", "Makefile"], "verifyCommand": "sh tests/container-alsa-check.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["both arch builds pass file checks", "container aplay pass + forced-reopen pass with reopen log line", "delta-based detection, bounded reopen retries"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: build-pak.sh wiring — staging, spawn/kill, ALSA env
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The pak ships and wires everything: sleepmon spawn (blocklist-gated) + cleanup kill, ALSA config generation + env export, asset staging with fail-closed arch checks.

**READ FIRST:** Task 1's findings comment — if it contradicts the conf/env template, correct the template accordingly before implementing.

- Create: `assets/gt-asound.conf` (template with @PAK_DIR@ placeholder; plan Task 4 Step 2)
- Modify: `build/build-pak.sh` — staging block near existing `cp "$ASSETS/…"` lines (~1247–1280, plan Step 3), `edit_portmaster_launch` gt-h700-sleepmon splice before the `"$PAK_DIR/bin/bash" "$ROM_PATH"` anchor (plan Step 4), gt-h700-sleepmon-kill splice at `cleanup() {` head (plan Step 5), E5 stub comment update (plan Step 6)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] gt-asound.conf: includes `</usr/share/alsa/alsa.conf>`, `pcm_type.gt_suspend` with `lib "@PAK_DIR@/lib/libasound_module_pcm_gt_suspend.so"`, stock hooks chain copy as `pcm.gt_stock_hooks`, `pcm.gt_stock_slave { type plug … }`, `pcm.!default { type gt_suspend slave.pcm "gt_stock_slave" }`
- [ ] Staging: bin/gt-sleepmon, lib plugin .so + .armhf.so, files/gt-sleep-blocklist.txt, files/gt-asound.conf; fail-closed `file` checks on sleepmon (aarch64) and armhf .so (32-bit ARM)
- [ ] Spawn splice: PLATFORM=h700-gated, blocklist check (pak file + user use-sleep-blocklist), sed-generates /tmp/gt-asound.conf, exports ALSA_CONFIG_PATH, spawns `"$PAK_DIR/bin/gt-sleepmon" $$ >/tmp/gt-sleepmon.log 2>&1 &`, records gt_sleepmon_pid=$!
- [ ] Kill splice at cleanup() head: kill $gt_sleepmon_pid if set + /proc/*/comm scan fallback for gt-sleepmon
- [ ] Edited launch.sh passes `sh -n`; markers idempotent; existing 21 test suites stay green

**Verify:** `GT_STAGE_EDIT_ONLY=<tmp with fixtures> sh build/build-pak.sh portmaster` then grep both markers + `sh -n`; `make test` → 21/21 green

tasks.subject: Task 6: Device gate — engine matrix on the RG SP
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove sleep/wake with working audio across every engine class on real hardware, from a real pak install, with Camille hands-on.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- None (device verification; fixes loop back through Tasks 2–5 with tests)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Local `make pak` build installed on the RG SP by unzip-over into Emus/h700/ (backups: launch.sh + lib as .pre-f47.bak; install while no port runs)
- [ ] Balatro (LÖVE/OpenAL): power-button sleep AND lid-close sleep; power wake; game alive, controls work, music audible after wake (Camille by ear); ≥3 consecutive cycles in one session
- [ ] Pizza Tower (preferred, exercises F30 FMOD) or Deltarune: sleep/wake with audio after wake
- [ ] Apotris (SDL_Renderer under gptokeyb): sleep/wake with audio; gptokeyb input works after wake
- [ ] Celeste (FNA/FAudio): sleep/wake with audio after wake
- [ ] Animal Crossing (armhf): sleep/wake; audio failure = documented per-port limitation (non-blocking per spec)
- [ ] After wake: volume keys (keymon) work; HUD toggle (F34/F35) works; Tunics! or BYTEPATH plays (remap regression); PortMaster GUI session normal; no gt-sleepmon leaked after GUI/port exit (/proc/*/comm scan clean)
- [ ] /tmp/gt-sleepmon.log shows trigger + `suspend rv=0` for ≥1 cycle (captured into task comment); no `T`-state stragglers post-wake

**Verify:** `ssh root@10.0.1.16 'cat /tmp/gt-sleepmon.log'` → `gt-sleepmon: trigger` + `suspend rv=0`; per-engine PASS confirmed by Camille in conversation; `ssh root@10.0.1.16 'for p in /proc/[0-9]*/comm; do [ "$(cat $p 2>/dev/null)" = gt-sleepmon ] && echo LEAKED; done; true'` prints nothing after exit. Then STOP — merge/push/release are Camille's calls.
